subject: english
question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined, out of which one word is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

Seema was a __timid__ girl. She did not talk to people who were not __familiar __to her. She was an __introvert__ since __adolosense__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**adolosense.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Among the given options, the word "adolosense" is incorrectly spelled.**
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is adolescence.**
 
 
• Adolescence refers to the period of life between childhood and adulthood.
 
 
• Example: The age between 10 to 19 is known as adolescence age.
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word 'adolescere' which means 'to grow up'.
 
 
 
• The correct usage in the sentence would be "She was an introvert since adolescence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **(introvert) **is correctly spelled and means a person who is reserved or shy.
 
• Option 2 **(timid)** is correctly spelled and means lacking in courage or confidence.
 
• Option 4 **(familiar)** is correctly spelled and means well-known or recognized.
